knownDataModelReality.authUserIdVsPrismaUserId: Supabase auth user_id may NOT equal Prisma User.id. Some assignments currently point at Prisma User.id; Tech session uses auth user_id from user_org_roles. This mismatch can cause 'assigned tasks not showing' unless mapping is consistent.

criticalIssueToFixNext.title: Tech 'Open' buttons return to /tech and tech cannot open a task directly
rootCause: Route group folders like src/app/(tech)/work-orders/[id] DO NOT add a /tech prefix; they collide with /(app)/work-orders/[id]. That caused build errors earlier.
There is likely a role-based redirect/guard that sends TECH users back to /tech when they attempt to visit /(app) routes like /work-orders/[id].
The Tech dashboard currently links to work-order pages; if the guard redirects TECH away from /(app), links will bounce back to /tech.

fixPlan.change: Create TECH detail routes under an actual /tech path segment (NOT just a route group).
fixPlan.notes: Because /tech is a real path segment in src/app/(tech)/tech, putting children under that folder yields /tech/work-orders/[id] etc and avoids collisions.

fixPlan.change: Update Tech dashboard links to /tech/work-orders/[id] and /tech/visits/[id] and add 'Open Task' linking to /tech/tasks/[id] (or a WO deep link).
acceptanceCriteria: Tech clicking Open on a WO opens /tech/work-orders/[id] (no redirect loop).
Tech clicking Open on a Visit opens /tech/visits/[id].
Tech clicking Open Task opens a task execution view (not just the WO page).

decision.recommended: Add /tech/tasks/[id] so a tech can open a task directly. Keep /tech/work-orders/[id] for context and package grouping.
